strings.game.title: Ember Reach
strings.menu.caption: KITE 01   /   PATROL CRAFT
strings.briefing.orders_line: Your orders are on the board, pilot.
strings.mission.objective.ore_convoy.escort: Escort the Cinder to Reach Relay
strings.mission.objective.ore_convoy.raiders: Destroy the raiders hitting the hauler
strings.radio.mission.ash_patrol.line_1: Fly the beacons in order, Kite 1. Log each one.
strings.radio.mission.ash_patrol.line_2: Three Jackals off the ash cloud. Engage.
strings.radio.mission.ash_patrol.line_3: Clean scopes. Bring it home, Kite.
strings.radio.mission.ore_convoy.line_1: Cinder under way, ore sealed. Stay close, militia.
strings.radio.mission.ore_convoy.line_2: Second raider group, cutting across the lane for the hauler!
strings.radio.mission.ore_convoy.line_3: Relay lock. Ore's safe. Drinks in Cinderfall are on me.
